idea-plugin.name: KTrapIC
idea-plugin.description:
Support for KTrapIC programs (*.ic10.kts): Kotlin compiled to IC10 for Stationeers' programmable chips.
  • The KTrapIC compiler's errors and warnings, marked in the editor as you type.
  • An IC10 tool window with the compiled program, normal or compact, its lines, bytes and registers against the chip's limits, and the compiler's warnings.
  • Settings for the compile daemon and the compile options (Settings > Tools > KTrapIC).
Programs are compiled by KTrapIC's compile daemon, run as a separate Java process.
